variant_selection_rule: Evaluate registered variants on identical chronological OOS/WFO splits with PIT gating. Compare LogLoss first, then Brier/Accuracy/ECE, stability, missingness, robustness, cost and frozen holdout. Do not select by column count.
runtime_truth: The prediction artifact's feature_set_id and feature_schema_hash are authoritative for the exact columns used.

feature_variant_screen.decision_rule: Screen on newest chronological holdout only after chronological model-validation selection; no auto-adoption. Any winner must repeat full WFO/OOS + calibration + ablation + robustness + frozen holdout.
